description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the AttendanceEditPunchInRecordOverlapAPI in the OrangeHRM attendance plugin. It contains setup methods, data providers, and test cases verifying API functionalities related to overlapping punch-in records during attendance editing, specifically testing the 'getOne' method while other CRUD operations are marked as not implemented.

classes.name: AttendanceEditPunchInRecordOverlapAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that performs integration tests on the AttendanceEditPunchInRecordOverlapAPI, focusing mainly on the 'getOne' operation with other methods expected to throw NotImplemented exceptions.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test data before all tests run, loading fixture data from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' API method using data-driven test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test case data from a YAML-defined set of scenarios for testing 'getOne'.

methods.description: Confirms that calling 'update' on the API throws a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.description: Verifies that 'getValidationRuleForUpdate' throws a 'not implemented' exception.
